evals.prompt: In an Express ESM app, integrate @igxjs/node-components SessionManager in SESSION mode. I need /auth/providers, /auth/callback, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, and /api/profile. The app may receive /auth/providers?app_id=tenant-a and /auth/refresh?app_id=tenant-a. For login, the UI should use the provider URL returned by /auth/providers.
evals.expected_output: Shows a singleton SessionManager, awaits setup before routes, wires identityProviders/callback/refresh/logout, uses authenticate + requireUser before SESSION refresh and protected routes, explains app_id query fallback to SSO_APP_ID, and does not create a custom login middleware or Axios POST to /auth/login/:idp.

evals.prompt: Help me migrate my node-components integration from cookie sessions to TOKEN mode for an SPA. Include config, callback behavior, refresh, logout all devices, and where token data is stored.
evals.expected_output: Uses SESSION_MODE: SessionMode.TOKEN with REDIS_URL, SSO_SUCCESS_URL, SSO_FAILURE_URL; explains callback HTML localStorage behavior, Authorization bearer usage, refresh behavior, uses requireUser before logout ?all=true, and Redis key pattern {SESSION_KEY}:{email}:{tid}.

evals.prompt: I want standardized Express errors using @igxjs/node-components. Show route-level httpError usage, Axios error conversion, Zod validation conversion, middleware order, and the JSON response shape.
evals.expected_output: Uses httpNotFoundHandler before httpErrorHandler, uses httpError/httpHelper.handleAxiosError/httpHelper.toZodMessage, notes zod must be installed separately, and shows flat response shape with status/message plus data fields at top level.

evals.prompt: My service is CommonJS on Node 20 and I need to use JwtManager from @igxjs/node-components for password reset links. Give me the right import style and a secure JWE example.
evals.expected_output: Uses dynamic import rather than require for Node 20 CommonJS, creates JwtManager with JWT_* constructor options, uses camelCase per-call options, uses a separate secret from SSO/session secrets, and decrypts with subject validation.

evals.prompt: Refactor my Express app to use FlexRouter. I have users and orders routers, and I want each feature router file to export its mount definitions instead of putting all new FlexRouter calls in app.js. Show both the feature file shape and the app.js mounting loop.
evals.expected_output: Defines `export const routers = [new FlexRouter(...)]` inside each feature route module, creates one FlexRouter per express.Router instance, keeps app.js limited to importing/combining those arrays and calling mount(app, basePath), and avoids using one FlexRouter as an aggregate for multiple routers.
